description:
Calculate the value/settlement date for a payment.

Determines when a payment will settle based on:
- Source and destination country holiday calendars
- Weekend conventions (Sat/Sun or Fri/Sat)
- Currency center holidays (if FX conversion involved)
- Settlement convention (T+0, T+1, T+2)

Examples:
  value_date("US", "DE")
  value_date("US", "DE", "fx_spot", "USD", "EUR")
  value_date("DE", "FR", "sepa")
  value_date("US", "US", "wire", from_date="2026-07-03")

base_currency.description: Base currency for FX, ISO 4217 (e.g. "USD"). Required when settlement_type is "fx_spot".

dest_country.description: Receiver's country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "DE").

from_date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today). You do not know today's date: omit this argument unless the user named a specific send date. If the user's date is relative ("the 20th", "next Friday", "month-end"), read the `today` block in any response from this tool, bank_holidays or is_business_day_check and resolve against that.

settlement_type.description: One of "wire" (T+0 domestic / T+1 international, the default), "fx_spot" (T+1 or T+2 depending on the pair), "sepa" (D+1), "sepa_instant" (T+0).

source_country.description: Sender's country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US").

target_currency.description: Target currency for FX, ISO 4217 (e.g. "EUR"). Required when settlement_type is "fx_spot".

name: value_date
title: Value Date Calculator
